definitions.short: a Tsorite or inhabitant of Tsor (i.e. Syrian)
definitions.full: H6876. Tsori צֹרִי adjective, of a people Tyrilan ; — צ ׳אִישׁ 1Kin 7:14 2Chr 2:13 ; plural as substantive הַצֹּרִים the Tyrians 1Chr 22:4 ; Ezra 3:7 (both + הַצִּידֹנִים ), Neh 13:16 . II. צֹר ( flint, knife ) see III. צרר .

occurrences.englishText: He was the son of a widow of the tribe of Naphtali, and his father was a man of Tyre, a worker in bronze; and he was filled with wisdom and understanding and skill, to work all works in bronze. He came to king Solomon, and performed all his work.
and cedar trees without number, for the Sidonians and the people of Tyre brought cedar trees in abundance to David.

They also gave money to the masons, and to the carpenters. They also gave food, drink, and oil to the people of Sidon and Tyre, to bring cedar trees from Lebanon to the sea, to Joppa, according to the grant that they had from Cyrus King of Persia.
Some men of Tyre also lived there, who brought in fish and all kinds of wares, and sold on the Sabbath to the children of Judah, and in Jerusalem.
